_comment: Voiceover script. 'text' is the exact wording used for the subtitles. 'eleven_prompt' is what is sent to ElevenLabs (audio tags in [brackets] steer delivery and are not spoken). 'start' is when the line begins in the video (seconds) and 'end_by' is the latest it may finish; longer takes are sped up slightly to fit.

narrator.description: Calm, friendly, a little playful, quick pace, neutral accent
narrator.elevenlabs_voice_name: Elena Wren - Friendly, warm and kind, with neutral accent

kid.description: About 10 years old, giving up, a little amused

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you put a scarecrow in your garden, the crows stay away. Sort of.
lines.eleven_prompt: [warmly] If you put a scarecrow in your garden, the crows stay away. [mischievously] Sort of.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But crows are smart, and they learn it never moves. So you add a motor that makes it spin.
lines.eleven_prompt: [playfully] But crows are smart, and they learn it never moves. So you add a motor that makes it spin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But they figure out the spinning pattern too. So you make it move at random times.
lines.eleven_prompt: [playfully] But they figure out the spinning pattern too. So you make it move at random times.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But they start sneaking in at night. So you add glowing eyes and a motion sensor.
lines.eleven_prompt: [mischievously] But they start sneaking in at night. [playfully] So you add glowing eyes and a motion sensor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But soon they're not scared of anything. So you add a speaker that plays hawk sounds.
lines.eleven_prompt: [playfully] But soon they're not scared of anything. So you add a speaker that plays hawk sounds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations, you built the scariest scarecrow ever.
lines.eleven_prompt: [warmly] Congratulations, you built the scariest scarecrow ever.
